competence.exam: checkpoint form: C0->unseen-exam-X0.jsonl, C1->X1, C2->X2, C3->X3, C4->X4; compression conditions->X0

acquisition.ATΛ_stable_rule: TT at the first checkpoint k from which competence holds at k and at every later checkpoint through C4; right-censored (> TT(C4)) if not competent at C4
acquisition.ATΛ_first_rule: TT at the first checkpoint meeting competence, regardless of later checkpoints; null if never competent
acquisition.TT_statistic: median over items i of the checkpoint's form of prompt_eval_count(k,i) - prompt_eval_count(NULL,i)

compression.competence_rule: same as competence block, evaluated per condition

context_isolation.compression_conditions: independent fresh runs; no teaching, feedback or hidden state carried between conditions
